title: Publish a broken-vs-fixed data comparison page
summary: Added docs/quality/fixes.html (local docs page, not published) with six before/after cards and a sign-rule context section, generated by contributor_tools/build_fixes_page.py from committed audit JSON only (no data reads, no new measurements; the only arithmetic is the sign/recipe compared and division by an audit-recorded mass). Cards: GT24 ankle sign vs README (GT24-C02), GT23 moment units (GT23-C02), GT23 normalizing mass (GT23-C03), UM21 ankle 180-degree alternate-branch stretch (UM21-C03), UM21 AB04/i0 reversed pelvis (UM21-P01), UM21 thigh/shank recipe (UM21-C01). A card is emitted only when its backlog task is done and its <task>-verify.json verdict (or status) is done; the builder checks this on every build. Status labels say no corrected files are released for any card. Linked from the quality page nav and status intro.
changed_files: docs/quality/index.html (static part only: one nav link and one sentence after the status intro; generated audit block untouched)
not_shown_with_reason: None of the requested findings are excluded now; the two UM21-T02 cards are shown under José's 2026-10-31 approved exception.

card_status_basis.GT23-C02: Values are N*m/kg; no corrected files released; rescaling pending under GT23-C04.

card_status_basis.UM21-C03: D-UM21-C03-2 = C (re-express, drop strides with jumps: 29 of 31 kept, matches audit count); not released.
card_status_basis.UM21-P01: D-UM21-P01-1 = C; UM21-P02 ready, not applied.
card_status_basis.UM21-C01: D-UM21-C01-1 = C (standard names from hip - pelvis); not released.
card_status_basis.sign rule: DOC-03 done/verified; rule B adopted 31 Oct; current downloads are legacy.
